text: It began in 1967, with expressive ties.
One piece. A much bigger world.
In 1972, the Polo shirt brought that vision into everyday life.
Prep, tailoring, and the outdoors shared one point of view.
Double RL looked west: denim, workwear, lived-in texture.
Purple Label arrived in 1995, sharpening the tailoring and the sense of occasion.
Ralph Lauren made a world you could wear.
